chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, Pasian' hong khualnate tungtawnin kong thum hi: Pasian' mai-ah a hinglai, a siangtho, a santaak biakpiak van bangin na pumpi uh luui un. Tua pen na hih ding uh biakpiakna ciiktak ahi hi.
Hih khanghun paizia kilawhsak kei unla, Pasian' deihna ahi, a hoih thu, a lungkimhuai thu, a cingtaak thu, cihte na sittel theih nadingun na lungsim uh thaksuahsakin mel na kikhel un.

Kei' tunga hong kiguan hehpihna tungtawnin na vekpi uh' tungah kong genin ah: noleno ahi ding zah valin kipi-ngaihsut lua kei unla khat ciat' tunga Pasian' hong hawmsak upna omzah tawh kituakin thulam tawnin om un.
A hang pen pumpi khat ah pumpi na tampi i nei a, tua pumpi nate a kimanna uh a kibang khin hilo hi.
Tua hi a, eite zong tampi i hih hangin Khris' sungah pumpi khat i hi a, khatlekhat a kizom pumpi nate i hi hi.
Ei' tunga hong kipia hehpihna zui-in hehpihna gah a tuam tek ngah i hih manin tuate zang ciat ni. I ngah pen kamsanna lam ahihleh i upna omzah zui-in zangin,
tanuk nasep lam ahihleh tanuk na i sepna ah, hilhcian lam ahihleh a hilhcianna ah,
hanthot lam ahihleh a hanthotna ah, piakkhiat lam ahihleh citna lungsim tawh, makaih lam ahihleh thasanna tawh, thukhual lam ahihleh maitaiina tawh, zang ciat ni.
Itna a taktak hisak un. A sia kih unla, a hoih pom un.
Sanggam ki-itna tawh khatlekhat ki-it unla zahtak kipiak lamsang khatlekhat kidem un.
Thasanna lamah thadah kei unla, lungsim thalawpin Topa' na sem un.
Lametna tawh lungdam unla, gentheihna sungah lungduai-in thungetna nei paisuak un.
Mi siangthote' kitangsapte piakhia unla zinleleng do na hahkat un.
No hong bawlsiate thupha pia un; amaute samsia kei unla thupha pia un.
A lungdamte lungdampih unla a kapte kahpih un.
Khatlekhat kithuhual un; kiliansak kei unla tualniamte tawh kikhawlthei un. Kipilsak se kei un.
Kuamah' tungah thusia khat thusia tawh thuk kei unla vekpi' muhna ah a hoih ding thu ngaihsun un.
Ahihtheih nakleh mi khempeuh tawh a kilem dingin om un.
Kong itte aw, phu la ngeikei unla Pasian' hehna a thuak dingin nusiat lel un. A hang pen, “Topa in, ‘Phulakna keima' a hi a, keimah'n ka thukkik ding hi,’ ci hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua ahih manin na galte a gilkial leh anvak un; a dangtak leh dawn theih ding pia un. A hang pen tua bangin na hih uhleh a luzang ah mei-am a lomkoih na hi uh hi.
Thusia kizosak kei unla, thusia pen thuhoih tawh a zo hizaw un.
